reproduce: python -m pipeline.discovery acquire --set global --set kz --set benchmark --set targets
notes: Native source windows were deleted after feature extraction; their SHA-256 are in the per-window records under data/derived (not committed). Re-running acquire restores them from the public COGs.
Windows on the same 22 km footprint are never duplicated; geo-0.1.0 windows are pooled at build time.
